{{EventEnd|date=31st of January 2024}} {{For|[[Christmas 2019 Event]]}} {{EventInfobox |image1 = XMAS2023RENDER.png |dates = 21 December 2023 – 31 January 2024 |tracks = 1 |previous_event = [[Lunar Overture Event|Lunar Overture]] |next_event = [[The Hunt Event|The Hunt]] |previous_pass = [[Lunar Overture Event#Lunar Overture Season Pass|Lunar Overture]] |next_pass = [[Hexscape Event#Hexscape Event Battle Pass|Hexscape]] }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''Krampus' Revenge Event''' was the thirteenth event to be added to Tower Defense Simulator. The event was released a few hours after the [[V1.11.0|Krampus' Revenge Update]], it brought one new event tower and a season pass, which required {{Cookies|Cookies}} to reach higher ranks. Both the event and season started on the 21st of December 2023 and ended on the 31st of January 2024, though the season ended a few hours before the event. ==Krampus' Revenge Season Pass== [[File:KRBattlepass.png|center|thumb|500px]] {{Cookies|Cookies}} were this event's currency. They were collected by killing enemies that spawned with randomly chosen present or elf hats. All naturally spawned enemies could spawn with one of these hats. These enemies dropped between one and three {{Cookies|Cookies}} when killed, which had to be collected by walking up to them. In [[Krampus Frosthold]], the chance that an enemy would drop {{Cookies|Cookies}} is 7.5%. In regular maps, this chance was reduced to 4.5%. In total, it would take {{Cookies|5,000 Cookies}} or {{Robux|2,445}} to complete the season pass. {{BattlePass |Pass = Krampus' Revenge |Pass Type = Season |Level Name = Rank |Regular Image = KrampusRevengeHat2.png|[[Sleigh (Krampus Frosthold)|Sleigh]] with one of the {{Cookies|Cookie}} currency hats. }} ==Trivia== *Originally, the {{Color|Krampus|Defender}} [[Mortar]] skin was not a part of this season pass, with the tenth rank giving the {{Color|Krampus|Warlord}} [[Minigunner]] skin instead. The ranks after the {{Color|Krampus|Warlord}} [[Minigunner]] skin appeared to be the same as the ones after in in the season pass before its removal. **Because of the {{Color|Krampus|Defender}} [[Mortar]] skin not being included, the season pass only required {{Cookies|4,500 Cookies}} to be completed instead of {{Cookies|5,000}}. **This old version of the season pass could be seen on one of the images provided in the in-game update log. *While the in-game update log stated that the gifts obtained from [[Quests#Santa Quests|Santa Quests]] could not be opened until the 24th of December 2023, this was not actually the case. They could be opened when the update was released. *Coincidentally, the '''Krampus' Revenge Event''' was released exactly one year after the [[Violent Night Event]]. *This was the first event to have limited-time [[Quests]]. {{EventNavBox}} [[Category:Passes]]
